use_cases.description: Propose an ontology mapping for a catalog item, for human review (ZTAX-CLS-REQ-0082). The AI output is an advisory classification proposal; a qualified human reviewer constructs the authoritative ClassificationDecision (ADR-0006 §2.6).

Explain one figure from the synthetic demo Reports dashboard (a KPI, a per-authority tax-assessed total, a monthly trend point or a filing-pipeline bucket), grounded only in the rows supplied with the call. Demo only -- the dashboard and its data are synthetic (intelligence/tools/report_fixture.py); this use case never reaches a real report.

Explain one row of the synthetic demo obligations register or of its payments / remittances tab, grounded only in the rows supplied with the call. Demo only -- the register is synthetic (intelligence/tools/report_fixture.py); this use case never reaches a real obligation.

Explain one row of the synthetic demo Shadow Assurance comparison, grounded only in the rows supplied with the call. Demo only -- the comparison is synthetic (intelligence/tools/report_fixture.py); this use case never reaches a real comparator run.
